verdicts.opus: D and B both measured volume, tone and geography from the same traced call. D went further: it named the peak and trough, caught the Colombia and tag-panel artefacts, and placed its limits beside the numbers they bound. B has cleaner complete exports, but answers less of the global country and story question; neither deliverable provides a verifiable linked reference set.
